method.definition: Maximum number of named derived-rule applications on a fact-to-target dependency chain across exported valid evaluation paths. Facts=0; Boolean, arithmetic and administrative wrappers=0. Parallel premises and composite claims use max, not sum.
method.finance: Count rule:baoxiao_rules.* nodes, including named policy helper/selection/aggregation definitions. Exclude rule:baoxiao_cases.* harness wrappers. Max over reference path roots, then max over case components.
method.law: Use the same Boolean rules and signed facts as validated reference generation. Count named concepts, triggers, defeated/applicable, no-liability and final result definitions. Explore outcome-supporting Boolean branches, choosing the maximum valid chain.
method.scope: Finite exported explanation system, not the longest unrestricted HOL proof and not the minimum required proof depth. Formalization granularity affects depth.
method.statistics: 16 models equal weight; 2000 case-bootstrap replicates. Slopes are linear descriptive associations, unadjusted for other case properties; confidence intervals unadjusted for multiplicity. HOL groups overlap; within-type variation does not remove all confounding.
method.outside: 20 outside cases included only in Overall.
